status_at_declaration: All five depth-3 members trained; their validation results reviewed; no model test predictions scored.

architecture_extension.paired_data: Reuse the baseline member's exact split and training-only normalization for the same seed
architecture_extension.training: Keep learning rate, batch size, dropout, optimizer, patience and maximum epochs identical to baseline
architecture_extension.selection: Minimum validation CE independently within each member; no test-based selection
architecture_extension.interpretation: Depth and parameter count change together; not a parameter-matched depth-only causal experiment

grad_cam.groups_defined_by: Depth-3 seed-101 best checkpoint with threshold strictly >0.5
grad_cam.selection: Uniform random within each reference group; use all if fewer than 3; do not backfill from other groups
grad_cam.target_layer: Output of the last convolution block's LeakyReLU, before pooling
grad_cam.mode: eval mode with gradients enabled, no optimizer or weight updates
grad_cam.map: Spatial-average gradient channel weights, weighted activation sum, ReLU, upsample to 64x60
grad_cam.scope: Single fixed-seed model per depth; not an ensemble attribution
grad_cam.caveat: Native map resolution differs across depth; normalized color intensity is not a cross-model absolute importance scale

test_inference.input_filter: finite EWMA_vol > 0 only; do not require observed future return to generate a prediction
test_inference.classification_mask: Eligible input, finite prediction and finite Ret_20d

baselines: Constant probability fitted from each member's saved training up fraction
Constant probability equal to the five training fractions' mean

financial_evaluation.return: Ret_month, distinct from the Ret_20d classification target
financial_evaluation.rebalance: One formation date per calendar month, monthend-to-next-monthend holding returns
financial_evaluation.universe: Input-eligible historical complete cases with finite Ret_month >= -1 and finite absolute MarketCap > 0; missing-return exclusion audited
financial_evaluation.selection_caveat: Complete-case filtering follows the reference code's historical comparison convention and can introduce return-availability selection bias; not a frictionless implementable-strategy guarantee
financial_evaluation.sort: Ten within-date percentile groups; first group includes its lower bound, subsequent groups exclude their lower bound and include upper bound
financial_evaluation.ties: If any group is empty or 10th/90th percentiles coincide, omit the date and audit it; do not invent zero returns
financial_evaluation.spread: High minus Low, 100% long and 100% short
financial_evaluation.annualized_return: 12 times mean observed monthly return; arithmetic, not CAGR
financial_evaluation.annualized_volatility: sqrt(12) times sample monthly standard deviation, ddof=1
financial_evaluation.sharpe: sqrt(12) times monthly mean divided by sample standard deviation; zero risk-free assumption
financial_evaluation.costs: Gross: no transaction costs, borrow fees or financing adjustment
financial_evaluation.missing_months: Report explicitly; do not fill zero; no cumulative wealth plot across internal gaps

guardrails: Keep the depth-3 training folder and weights unchanged
Do not choose architectures, seeds, thresholds or blend weights from test scores
Report single-member and ensemble test results separately
Different training years and return labels prevent a strict numerical identity claim relative to the paper
Record input and checkpoint hashes and allow safe per-year prediction resume
